question_en: Compare the top 5 TSs by CR count against their section counts (complexity vs. change frequency).
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec {specNumber: ts}) RETURN ts, crCount, count(sec) AS sectionCount ORDER BY crCount DESC
reference_query:
MATCH (sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber IN ["38.201", "38.202", "38.211", "38.212", "38.213", "38.214", "38.215", "38.291"]
WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(target:Spec)
WHERE target.specNumber = specNumber
WITH specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(owner:Spec)
WHERE owner.specNumber = specNumber
RETURN specNumber, crCount, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, specNumber ASC
